faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal (AIIMS Bhopal) for filling up contractual healthcare positions in Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by AIIMS Bhopal?
faq.answer: The position advertised is Program Support Associate (I-FETP) under the I-FETP project located in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Program Support Associate (I-FETP) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Program Support Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree from a recognized University along with a minimum of 03 years of post-qualification experience in relevant government or public health institutions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably not exceeding 40 years, with upper age relaxations applicable for reserved category candidates as per Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated maximum remuneration of up to ₹50,000/- per month on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the application form via email or hand/post is 13-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in test or interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The tentative date for the walk-in test or interview is scheduled for 15-10-2026 at the designated institute premises in Bhopal.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by submitting their application form and documents by hand, post, or by emailing them to [email protected] as a single PDF file.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for AIIMS Bhopal Program Support Associate?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises screening of applications, a written test (if applicants are 10 or more), a computer skill test, and a final personal interview.
